label: Water
rawMetric: mean of clip(WUE/3), clip(aquiferRisk/20) [groundwater sites], clip(DVS/0.5), clip(EWIF/2)

label: Health
rawMetric: totalHealthCost / totalMWh (2024 $ per MWh of facility electricity; population-weighted local plume + grid-attributable burden at EPA benefit-per-ton; 0-120, the ceiling being the most damaging contiguous-US eGRID subregion)

label: Community
rawMetric: netCommunityValueExHealthPerMW ($M per MW-yr, ledger ex-health; inverted: +0.5 → 0, -1.0 → 1)

label: E-Waste
rawMetric: embodiedIntensity = annualised embodied carbon / IT MW (tCO2e per MW-yr, 0-1800); the embodied default is IT-capacity based (5 tCO2e per kW IT, Schneider WP99), so it does not depend on the assumed servers per MW

label: Heat Island
rawMetric: uhiEstimate (C): anthropogenic box-model deltaT + albedo and impervious warming, less the on-site vegetation offset (capped at the land-cover warming)
